task: Swallow the expected AbortError when a WaveformStrip effect tears down (showWave flips false) before wavesurfer's load() resolves

frontend/src/app/layout/WaveformStrip.ts.summary: ws.load(audioUrl) is no longer fire-and-forget: attaches a .catch that swallows AbortError (expected when ws.destroy() aborts the in-flight decode fetch during cleanup, e.g. when the optimistic duration=0 mount is torn down right after the real duration arrives) and console.error-logs any other load failure instead of letting it surface as an uncaught rejection.
